messages:
maria: Heads up — noticed a p99 latency jump on llama3-13b (hosted) right after enabling the chat template default. Profiler shows the kernel selector falling back to a slow matmul path after a KV eviction event.
jon: Can you paste the perf traces / which fallback path it picks? FP32 GEMM or something else?
maria: Perf snippet from the trace: 
```
kernel_selector: chosen=matmul_slow
reason: kv_stride_mismatch | head_dim=128 hidden=8192 rope_theta=1000 chat_prefix_len=96
notes: fallback happens at step ~512-768; increased memcpy and unoptimized matmul time
```
kevin: That kv_stride_mismatch reason is interesting — we saw similar when prefix padding causes misaligned KV tile boundaries. Also RMSNorm/SiLU interplay can force float casts that make the fused kernels ineligible.
sam: Also confirm SiLU fusion is available for the Llama3 build we're using. If SiLU isn't fused the kernel matcher can prefer safe slower kernels. Can we reproduce locally with a tight script?
maria: Repro script I used: 
```
python perf_probe.py --model llama3-13b --chat-template default --seq 800 --batch 2
```
jon: I ran that with batch=4 seq=800, p99 went 120ms -> 480ms. Timeline shows repeated KV cache evictions causing kernel reselection. The eviction frequency spikes when chat_prefix_len + user tokens exceed cache_chunk_size.
maria: Proposed mitigations: 1) Add per-model kernel hint to bias the selector toward fused_kv_path for head_dim=128 combos. 2) Increase cache_chunk_size default for chat templates (128->256). 3) Add a chat-template prefetch/pad that aligns KV tiles to avoid stride mismatch.
kevin: +1 on per-model kernel hints; we already have a kernel_hint API in the selector but it's unused for most Llama variants. We should keep it behind a feature flag and bake unit tests.
sam: Also double-check rope_theta defaults. If rope scaling is set to a nonstandard value (we've seen 1000 vs 10_000 variants), attention math changes slightly and some optimized kernel contracts fail.
jon: Example quick-config that fixed my run: 
```
{ "model": "llama3-13b", "head_dim": 128, "hidden_size": 8192, "rope_theta": 1000, "preferred_kernel": "fused_kv_v2", "cache_chunk_size": 256 }
```
maria: After forcing preferred_kernel=fused_kv_v2 and bumping chunk to 256 p99 dropped back to ~150ms. Throughput for tiny sequences dipped a bit but p99 improved significantly under mixed chat loads.
kevin: Action items: 
- add per-model kernel_hint mapping: (family, head_dim, hidden_size) -> kernel
- add chat-template alignment/prefetch so prefix lengths don't cause stride mismatch
- expand SiLU/RMSNorm fused-op coverage and add a selector test to detect fallback to slow matmul
- run long-running perf job on Dedicated with mixed batch sizes to validate
sam: I'll open a PR for kernel-hints + small benchmark harness to reproduce the p99 spike. Will include the perf_probe script and a minimized dataset.
perf-bot: perf CI job queued: perf/llama3-chattemplate/3509000000
jon: Thanks all — I'll follow up tomorrow with fuller repro logs and a short flamegraph. :thumbsup:
